International admission is standard (Polytechnique has large international enrollment); official admission requirement: undergraduate engineering degree or equivalent. Microelectronics and bio-engineering is listed as one of the program's two optional specialization fields. Home to the Interdisciplinary Institute of Technological Innovation (3IT) and the Laboratory of Nanotechnologies and Nanosystems (LN2, joint CNRS unit) — strong VLSI/microelectronics research hub, hence Tier A despite French-medium instruction. Deadline: March 1 for fall-only admission.

Photonics and microelectronics is one of the program's named specializations alongside power distribution networks, supporting Tier A. Instruction is French-medium; no English track found. International tuition (~CAD 24,737/yr per third-party aggregator, unverified on official page).
